# Rothian Digital

> The AI-native creative marketing agency. Human creativity, AI velocity.
> Strapline: Reimagining your business. Operating across the United Kingdom and the UAE.
> Part of the Rothian group (Powering Business), alongside Rothian Technology and Rothian Cyber.

Rothian Digital helps businesses go from grey and generic to unmistakable. We work in four
stages — Start with Strategy, Build Your Brand, Grow Your Audience, Optimize & Scale — using the
method Discover, Define, Design, Develop. Commercial promise: no upfront costs, no bs.

## What we do

- Brand Strategy & Identity: brand story, vision, positioning and visual identity.
- Visual Branding: logo, colour, typography and brand guidelines.
- Website Creation: fast, accessible, conversion-focused sites, built machine-readable for AI and
  agentic discovery from day one.
- Mobile App Development: iOS, Android and cross-platform apps.
- Customer Experience Design (UI/UX): research-led interface and journey design.
- Generative Creative Studio: AI-accelerated design, video and brand assets under human art
  direction.
- Virtual Event Production: branded, interactive virtual events and webinars.
- Social Media Growth: community building on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok with AI-assisted
  content engines.
- Content Creation: visuals, video and copywriting, scaled with generative tooling and
  quality-controlled by people.
- AI Agents & Conversational Commerce: chat, WhatsApp and voice agents, agentic ads and
  conversational checkout.
- Paid Advertising & Lead Generation: Google, Meta and LinkedIn campaigns with AI creative testing.
- Online Store Setup (E-commerce): storefronts and checkout optimisation, including readiness for
  AI shopping agents.
- Search & AI Visibility (SEO + AEO/GEO): ranking for people and being the cited answer inside
  ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and Copilot.
- AI-Readiness / Machine-Readable Web: structured data, schema and llms.txt implementation.
- AI Insights & Predictive Analytics: measurement, forecasting and AI-surfaced recommendations.

## Proof

- GITEX Global 2025 — multi-channel LinkedIn and email campaign: 6 qualified leads, 1 new client,
  600+ website visits, 33.45% email open rate, final spend under $900 of a $2,000 budget (50%+ saved).
- ADIPEC 2025 — email programme: 5,000 emails, 3,000 opens, 1,000+ clicks, 60% open rate against a
  21.5% industry average, 20% click-through against a 2.3% average.
- GISEC 2025 (Rothian Cyber) — LinkedIn campaign: 280 website visits at $0.64 cost per visit
  (43.5% below benchmark), 2.65% CTR, 813 InMails at a 55.47% open rate.
- Ordtek — website redesign delivered in 8 weeks (3 March to 28 April 2025), aligned to Ordtek and
  Venterra Group brand standards.
- The Modern Carat — sustainable luxury brand identity for lab-grown diamond jewellery.
- Exchange Legal Services — visual identity and social system for a UK legal practice.

## How we use AI

Generation is the cheapest part of our process; judgement is the expensive part. We brief before we
prompt, lock art direction as an approved keyframe, generate widely and curate hard, then finish
every asset with a human pass — grade, retouch, sound, upscale and QA. We disclose AI-generated
advertising where platforms or regulators require it, never ship an unreviewed generation, and keep
client assets and data out of public training sets.
